name: Question:  A seller buys a certain number of bananas at the rate of 8 for Rs. 5 and sells them at the rate of 5 for Rs. 8. What will be his profit percentage?  Hindi: एक विक्रेता केले 8 के लिए ₹5 की दर से खरीदता है और 5 के लिए ₹8 की दर से बेचता है। उसका लाभ प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए।
description:
Trick:

Buy Quantity = 8
Sell Quantity = 5

Cross Multiply:

CP Ratio = 5 × 5 = 25
SP Ratio = 8 × 8 = 64

Profit = 64 - 25 = 39

Profit % = (39/25) × 100
         = 156%

Answer = 156%

Yaad Rakhne Ki Line:
"8 ka 5 mein kharida,
5 ka 8 mein becha,
Cross multiply kiya,
156% profit nikla."
